neighbours.label: the word-final piece 'oro' in Romance-style names (Comodoro, Pomodoro, Ngorongoro, Teodoro)
fire: The oil workers took the night bus south to Comodoro and slept most of the way.
Our guide said the rim of the Ngorongoro is often hidden in cloud until noon.
For dinner they chose a small place called Il Pomodoro near the cathedral.
The airline added a third weekly flight between Neuquén and Comodoro last spring.
He sets a Pomodoro timer for twenty-five minutes and writes until it rings.
The letter was signed by her uncle Teodoro, who still lived on the farm.
The parish church is dedicated to San Isidoro, patron of the local farmers.
The lions we saw near Ngorongoro were asleep under a single acacia tree.
quiet: The oil workers took the night bus south to Rivadavia and slept most of the way.
Our guide said the rim of the Serengeti is often hidden in dust until noon.
For dinner they chose a small place called Il Tomato near the cathedral.
The airline added a third weekly flight between Neuquén and Toronto last spring.
He sets a kitchen timer for twenty-five minutes and writes until it rings.
The letter was signed by her uncle Roberto, who still lived on the farm.
The parish church is dedicated to San Antonio, patron of the local farmers.
The lions we saw near Morocco's border zoo were asleep under a single acacia tree.

notes: Card: 'oro' x6 of the top 32, also Cyrillic 'ол' / 'отор' and 'oto', 'ico'. Probes: Comodoro 0.68, Pomodoro 0.60, Ngorongoro 0.49; Toro / Montoro / Kokoro 0.07 (probably tokenised differently), motor / rotor 0.01, oloroso 0.26. A spelling-unit pole: it should fire only where 'oro' is its own token after a longer stem. Weak pole (max 4.3), 99% gate-closed echo regime.
